brief:
Israeli forces intensified attacks on southern Lebanon today, launching airstrikes and directing sustained artillery barrages at multiple locations, Shehab Wire reported. The strikes continued a pattern of Israeli assaults on border communities in the region.

A correspondent for Russia Today was among those reporting on the escalated bombardment, though further details on casualties or specific targets were not immediately available.

title: Israel escalates airstrikes and artillery fire on southern Lebanese towns
